name: barbell-hack-squat.html
instructions:
1. Position the bar just behind your calves and set up with a shoulder width stance.
2. Reach down and grasp the bar with a double overhand (pronated) grip and assume your normal deadlift starting position. However, set up with your torso in a slightly more vertical fashion.
3. Take a breath and initiate the movement by driving your feet into the floor.
4. Stand tall as you extend the knees and hips simultaneously to bring the bar to lockout.
5. Lower back to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
